dataSync.title: Data sync
dataSync.indicator.label: Data sync: {{status}}
dataSync.description: Keep the structure you build — custom properties with their options, and extension groups — the same on your devices. Nothing in your library travels: no resources, no values, no files.
dataSync.notAvailable: Data sync is managed from this device's own window, or from a desktop app that manages it.
dataSync.manageElsewhere: Turning sharing on and approving devices happens on the device itself, or from a device paired with it.
dataSync.error.network: Could not reach data sync on this device. Check the connection and try again.
dataSync.error.server: Data sync could not do that. Try again in a moment.
dataSync.restore.pending: This device's data looks restored from a backup. Data sync is paused until you decide how to go on.
dataSync.kind.lastOne: At least one type of definition stays on.
dataSync.diagram.label: Devices this device syncs definitions with
dataSync.diagram.empty: This device does not sync with any other device yet. Choose Sync with another device to start.
dataSync.diagram.hint: Select a device, or its line, to see what syncs with it and to change it.
dataSync.arrow.receive.label: receives
dataSync.arrow.read.label: may read
dataSync.arrow.receive.off: This device does not receive {{name}}'s definitions
dataSync.arrow.read.offHint: {{name}} can read this device's definitions only after it asks and you approve, or with a code from this device.
dataSync.arrow.read.stopTitle: Stop {{name}} from reading this device's definitions?
dataSync.arrow.read.stopDescription: It keeps what it has, and can ask again later.
dataSync.off.title: Stop receiving from {{name}}?
dataSync.off.description: Nothing is deleted. Turning it on again picks up where it stopped.
dataSync.off.stillReads: {{name}} can still read this device's definitions.
dataSync.follow.title: Receive {{name}}'s definitions?
dataSync.follow.confirm: If this device cannot read {{name}}'s definitions yet, {{name}} is asked to approve. It is told:
dataSync.twoWay.title: Keep in step with {{name}} both ways?
dataSync.twoWay.consent: This also lets {{name}} read this device's definitions. Its renames, new options and removal of unused options will apply here by themselves.
dataSync.twoWay.consentCode: The device that uses this code may also ask this device to keep in step with it. Its renames, new options and removal of unused options will then apply here by themselves.
dataSync.twoWay.turnsOnSharing: This also turns on “Let devices I approve read this device's definitions”.
dataSync.copyOnce.title: Copy {{name}}'s definitions once?
dataSync.copyOnce.description: This device reads {{name}}'s definitions and shows you the first sync review before anything changes. Afterwards it does not keep receiving.
dataSync.request.follow: {{name}} asks to read this device's definitions: custom properties with their options, and extension groups. It cannot read your library, accounts, keys or folders, and it cannot change anything here.
dataSync.request.twoWay: {{name}} asks to keep definitions in step with this device, both ways. Approving lets it read this device's definitions, and this device reads its definitions in return. Its renames, its new options and its removal of options nobody uses here then apply here by themselves; anything else waits for you.
dataSync.request.from: From {{address}}. Only approve your own devices.
dataSync.request.claim: This request says it comes from {{name}}, which this device knows at {{known}}. It came from {{from}}.
dataSync.request.replacesExisting: A device this one knows under the same ID can already read this device's definitions. Approving replaces that access with this request's: if the request is not from that device, the device loses its access.
dataSync.request.replacesExistingReadBac: Receiving back then also reads that ID's definitions from the address this request offers, instead of from that device.
dataSync.request.receiveBack: Also receive {{name}}'s definitions here (keep in step both ways)
dataSync.request.approved: Approved. {{name}} can now read this device's definitions.
dataSync.request.approvedBothWays: Approved. {{name}} can now read this device's definitions, and this device receives its definitions in return.
dataSync.request.approvedReadBackFailed: Approved. {{name}} can now read this device's definitions, but reading its definitions back failed: {{reason}}. Try again from its details.
dataSync.requests.title: Requests
dataSync.sharing.label: Let devices I approve read this device's definitions
dataSync.sharing.hint: Only for your own devices. Never includes library content, accounts, cookies, keys or folders.
dataSync.sharing.remoteAccess: This also turns on remote access, with pairing required.
dataSync.sharing.onTitle: Let devices you approve read this device's definitions?
dataSync.sharing.offDescription: Devices that read this device's definitions stop receiving its changes. They keep what they have, and nothing changes here.
dataSync.sharing.isOn: Devices this device approved may read its definitions.
dataSync.sharing.isOff: Other devices cannot read this device's definitions.
dataSync.remoteAccess.offLine: Remote access is off, so no device can read this device's definitions.
dataSync.remoteAccess.onDescription: Devices you approve read this device's definitions over remote access; while it is off, none of them can.
dataSync.remoteAccess.onWarning: It is turned on with pairing required.
dataSync.self.title: This device
dataSync.invitation.title: A code for another device
dataSync.invitation.intro: Another device can use a one-time code to read this device's definitions without waiting for an approval. The code works once, for 10 minutes.
dataSync.invitation.allowTwoWay: Also keep this device in step with the device that uses the code
dataSync.invitation.use: On the other device, open Data sync, choose Sync with another device, then Enter an address and a code.
dataSync.invitation.expired: This code has expired. Create a new one.
dataSync.invitation.needsSharingFirst: A code for {{name}} only works while this device shares its definitions and remote access is on. What is off is turned on first, then the code is created.
dataSync.invitation.turnOnFirst: A code only works while this device shares its definitions and remote access is on. What is off is turned on first, then the code is created.
dataSync.readers.title: Devices that read this device
dataSync.readers.none: No other device reads this device's definitions.
dataSync.pause.deletionsHint: Nothing was deleted here. Apply as usual decides each deletion as always; Review the deletions puts each one in Needs you.
dataSync.pause.resetHint: {{name}} was reset, which ended this device's access. Ask it for access again to start over, or stop syncing.
dataSync.pause.duplicatedHint: Two devices publish as {{name}}. On the one that is a copy, open {{mode}} → {{page}} → {{panel}} and choose {{action}}, then resume.
dataSync.pause.tooManyHint: Decide some of the waiting changes, then resume.
dataSync.pause.startAnywayHint: {{name}} has not finished its first review for a week. Starting anyway merges as usual: definitions that match only by name wait in Needs you.
dataSync.link.approveThere: On {{name}}: Data sync → Requests, or federation datasync approve on a NAS.
dataSync.link.readBackAgain: Trying again sends {{name}} a request to let this device read its definitions; approve it on {{name}}.
dataSync.link.decideThere: Decide on {{name}} itself, in its own window.
dataSync.link.switchNeedsManagement: To switch this window to {{name}}, pair with it for management first ({{mode}} → {{page}}).
dataSync.link.peerKeepsInStep: {{name}} keeps in step with this device · read {{time}}
dataSync.link.missingAtPeer: {{count}} definitions are no longer offered by {{name}}; nothing was changed here.
dataSync.link.missingAtPeer_one: {{count}} definition is no longer offered by {{name}}; nothing was changed here.
dataSync.link.reset.title: Reset the sync state with {{name}}?
dataSync.link.reset.description: This device forgets what it agreed with {{name}} and stops syncing with it. Every definition stays as it is here. Syncing again later starts with a new first sync.
dataSync.link.stopReading.title: Stop reading {{name}}'s definitions?
dataSync.link.stopReading.description: This device gives up its access to {{name}}'s definitions. What it copied stays. Syncing again needs a new approval.

dataSync.status.NeedsYouThere_one: {{name}} has {{count}} change waiting for a decision

dataSync.status.paused.LocalRestoreDetec: Paused: this device's data looks restored
dataSync.status.paused.LocalRestoreSuspe: Paused: {{name}} has seen newer changes from this device than it has
dataSync.status.paused.TooManyDecisions: Paused: too many changes wait for you
dataSync.status.ReaderOnly: {{name}} reads this device; this device does not receive from it
dataSync.status.level.Offline: A device is offline · last synced {{time}}
dataSync.status.level.OfflineNever: A device is offline · never synced
dataSync.status.level.UpdateNeeded: A device needs an update to sync
dataSync.status.level.ToReview: {{count}} first syncs are ready to review
dataSync.status.level.ToReview_one: Ready to review the first sync
dataSync.status.peersNeedingDecisions: {{count}} devices have changes waiting for a decision
dataSync.status.peersNeedingDecisions_on: {{count}} device has changes waiting for a decision
dataSync.peerError.Unreachable: the other device could not be reached
dataSync.peerError.AccessMissing: this device has no access to its definitions
dataSync.peerError.AccessRevoked: its access for this device was withdrawn
dataSync.peerError.PeerSharingOff: it no longer shares its definitions
dataSync.peerError.ThisTooOld: this device's Bakabase is too old

dataSync.peerError.SnapshotExpired: the read took too long and expired

dataSync.peerError.PeerRestorePending: it is waiting for a decision after a restore

dataSync.problem.Busy: Another data sync operation is running; try again in a moment.
dataSync.problem.ApplyInProgress: Changes are being applied right now; try again once that is done.
dataSync.problem.DecisionsInvalid: Some choices no longer match what was fetched. Look at them again.
dataSync.problem.PlanChanged: What was fetched changed meanwhile. Look at it again.
dataSync.problem.UnknownKind: This build does not know that type of definition.
dataSync.problem.ReviewExpired: That review has expired. Fetch again.
dataSync.problem.UndoNotAvailable: That can no longer be undone.
dataSync.problem.PeerUnreachable: The other device could not be reached.
dataSync.problem.AccessMissing: This device has no access to the other device's definitions yet.
dataSync.problem.AccessRevoked: The other device withdrew this device's access.
dataSync.problem.PeerSharingOff: The other device does not share its definitions. On it, open Data sync → This device and turn on sharing.
dataSync.problem.PeerTooOld: The other device's Bakabase is too old for data sync. Update it.
dataSync.problem.ThisTooOld: This device's Bakabase is too old to sync with the other device. Update it.
dataSync.problem.PeerReset: The other device looks reset. Ask it for access again.
dataSync.problem.LinkExists: This device already syncs with that device.

dataSync.problem.RemoteAccessOff: Remote access is off on this device. Turn it on, with pairing required, first.
dataSync.problem.detail.DecisionsInvalid: “Start anyway” is offered once the other device has had time for its first review. Try again later.

dataSync.problem.detail.Busy.notRunning: Data sync is not running right now, so nothing could be synced. Try again in a moment.

dataSync.entity.intro: How each definition on this device syncs. A definition kept on this device only, or no longer synced, is never offered to other devices.
dataSync.entity.onlyApart: Only those not synced in full
dataSync.entity.none: No definitions of this type yet.
dataSync.entity.noneApart: Every definition of this type is synced in full.
dataSync.entity.tooManyOptions: Too many options to sync; sync the definition only?
dataSync.entity.action.definitionOnlyOn: Sync the definition only (not its options)
dataSync.entity.definitionOnly.everyDevi: Applies on every device this one syncs with.
dataSync.entity.definitionOnly.offDescri: Turning this off combines the options of every device into one list. Nothing is removed.
dataSync.entity.detach.title: Stop syncing {{name}}?
dataSync.entity.detach.description: It stays on this device as it is, and is no longer offered to other devices. It can sync again later.
dataSync.wizard.chooseIntro: Choose the device to sync with.
dataSync.wizard.candidate.notSharing: doesn't share its definitions: turn it on there
dataSync.wizard.candidate.readable: this device can read it already
dataSync.wizard.candidate.manageElsewher: asking it for access happens on the device itself, or from a device paired with it
dataSync.wizard.byAddress: Enter an address and a code
dataSync.wizard.notListed: Not listed, or not sharing? On that device, open Data sync → This device and turn on “Let devices I approve read this device's definitions”. That also turns on remote access.
dataSync.wizard.howWith: How should this device sync with {{name}}?
dataSync.wizard.explain.follow: This device receives {{name}}'s changes. Where both changed the same thing, {{name}}'s version wins.
dataSync.wizard.explain.twoWay: Both devices receive each other's changes. Where both changed the same thing, it waits for you.
dataSync.wizard.explain.copyOnce: Review {{name}}'s definitions once and apply what you choose. Nothing syncs afterwards.
dataSync.wizard.requested: Request sent. Approve it on {{name}} (Data sync → Requests, or federation datasync approve … on a NAS).
dataSync.wizard.ready: Ready to review the first sync with {{name}}.
dataSync.wizard.fetching: This device is reading {{name}}'s definitions. The first sync review is ready on this page in a moment.

dataSync.review.twoWayNote: What you keep here, and any name you choose, is also sent to {{name}}.

dataSync.review.planChanged: What was fetched changed meanwhile. The review was read again.

dataSync.undo.title: Undo: {{kind}}
dataSync.undo.nothing: There is nothing left to undo.
dataSync.undo.note.remove: These stay unsynced with {{name}} until you include them again. {{name}} keeps them.
dataSync.undo.note.unlink: This device stops taking {{name}}'s changes to them. {{name}} keeps its link until you stop syncing them there.

dataSync.undo.settingsLoseIt: Settings that use it will lose it.

dataSync.restore.title: This device's data looks restored

dataSync.restore.evidence.peer: Evidence: {{name}} has seen newer changes from this device. Only syncing with {{name}} is paused.
dataSync.restore.evidence.both: Evidence: this device's own records, and {{name}} has seen newer changes from this device.
dataSync.restore.thisDeviceWins.title: This device's definitions win
dataSync.restore.thisDeviceWins.short: The other devices take this device's definitions for everything they had seen. Their changes this device never saw arrive as conflicts, never as silent overwrites.
dataSync.restore.thisDeviceWins.descript: Every definition this device syncs gets a new version that wins over what the other devices have seen. Syncing then resumes.
dataSync.restore.othersWin.title: Take the other devices' definitions
dataSync.restore.othersWin.short: The next sync compares everything once, and takes the other devices' version where they differ. Deletions still ask you first.
dataSync.restore.othersWin.description: The next sync compares everything with the other devices once and takes their version where it differs. Nothing with values is deleted without asking. Syncing then resumes.

dataSync.restore.later.short: Nothing syncs on the paused links until you decide.
dataSync.restore.nothing: Nothing to decide: this device's data does not look restored.
dataSync.restore.applying: Applying your choice… Syncing resumes once it is done.
dataSync.restore.failed: Your choice could not be applied. Choose again, or try later.
